findings.summary: Code is shown before the idea behind it is stated on the TestClient page.
findings.evidence: "Synchronous: plain def test, no await" followed directly by the python block; the lifespan rule appears only afterwards in the table and the Remember line.
findings.fix: Add a one-line idea such as "Use with TestClient(app) so lifespan runs" immediately before the code block.

findings.summary: The Common Mistake bullets cover two separate mistakes and the stated result lacks a cause for each.
findings.evidence: "Testing against a running uvicorn server" / "Using a real database in tests" / "Result: tests are slow and flaky"
findings.fix: Split into two bullets, each with its own consequence, e.g. "Running uvicorn: slow, needs a port" and "Real DB: shared state makes tests flaky".

findings.summary: The test pyramid is given as fragmentary labels with no visual, so the levels cannot be read as a pyramid.
findings.evidence: "Unit / pure functions, many / Client / endpoints via TestClient / Real network / few"
findings.fix: Render it as a 3-row table or diagram with columns Level, What it tests, How many (many, some, few), and give the Client level a count.

findings.summary: The AsyncClient section states the lifespan row in the table as "not run" but the cheat sheet says "none", and the TestClient lifespan wording differs between pages.
findings.evidence: Page 2: "Lifespan | runs inside with | not run"; Page 6: "Lifespan | only inside with | none"
findings.fix: Use the same wording on both pages, e.g. "runs only inside with" and "not run (use LifespanManager)".

findings.summary: The AsyncClient code is shown before the idea is stated and the marker advice conflicts between 'pytest-asyncio or anyio' and the code, which gives only the anyio marker.
findings.evidence: "Async tests need pytest-asyncio or the anyio marker" then code uses only "@pytest.mark.anyio"; Common mistakes say "@pytest.mark.anyio / asyncio marker"
findings.fix: Name one default (anyio marker) and say pytest-asyncio uses @pytest.mark.asyncio, in one separate bullet.

findings.summary: The Fixtures section crams several ideas into single bullets.
findings.evidence: "Test DB: session in a transaction or in-memory SQLite, override get_db to yield it, roll back after"; "Scope: function (default) isolates tests; session speeds up setup like creating tables"
findings.fix: Split the Test DB bullet into one bullet per step (DB choice, override get_db, roll back), and the Scope bullet into function vs session.

findings.summary: The page contains no answer for the "Override never matches" fix beyond a restatement, and the code override example is shown with a lambda before explaining the key rule is the same object.
findings.evidence: "The route's Depends holds a different object (wrapped or re-created). The key must be the same object."
findings.fix: Add a concrete example of the mismatch, e.g. a decorator-wrapped dependency, and the fix of importing and keying on the exact object the route uses.

findings.summary: The precedence ladder is shown as scattered fragments rather than an ordered list, so the order and direction are unclear.
findings.evidence: "Init args / wins / Env vars / .env file / Defaults / last"
findings.fix: Write it as a numbered list: 1. Init args (wins), 2. Env vars, 3. .env file, 4. Defaults (last).

findings.summary: The FastAPI wiring code block is shown with no stated idea first and the final bullet is a bare fragment.
findings.evidence: "3. FastAPI wiring" followed straight by code; "@lru_cache builds Settings once"
findings.fix: Open with a bullet such as "Cache Settings with @lru_cache and inject via Depends so tests can override it", then the code.

findings.summary: The Gunicorn command uses uvicorn.workers.UvicornWorker without saying that this module is deprecated in current Uvicorn.
findings.fix: Say that uvicorn.workers has been deprecated since Uvicorn 0.30 and that the separate uvicorn-worker package (uvicorn_worker.UvicornWorker) replaces it. Alternatively, recommend plain uvicorn --workers N or fastapi run --workers N.

findings.summary: The Running Uvicorn bullets mix several ideas, and the dev/worker/Gunicorn comparison is text rather than a table.
findings.evidence: "--workers N starts several processes (or fastapi run --workers 4)"; "Gunicorn is a process manager using UvicornWorker" / "Newer Uvicorn has its own supervisor, so Gunicorn is optional"
findings.fix: Replace with a table of Command, Use, and Note (--reload dev only, --workers N, Gunicorn+UvicornWorker), one idea per row.

findings.summary: The Common mistakes bullet holds two separate mistakes in one line.
findings.evidence: "Shell-form CMD: signals are not forwarded, graceful shutdown breaks. Binding 127.0.0.1: the container port is unreachable."
findings.fix: Split into two bullets, one per mistake.

findings.summary: The cheat sheet is inconsistent with page 5 and the Docker row omits --port while the mistakes are mixed into the Run table without a heading.
findings.evidence: "Shell-form CMD: signals lost, shutdown breaks / Bind 127.0.0.1: container port unreachable / No async marker: test skipped or errors" listed under "3. Run"
findings.fix: Move the three mistakes under their own "Common mistakes" heading, with the async-marker item placed in section 1.
